ship_id.description: HEMS ship_id i:<IANA-PEN>_u:<VPID> — the IANA PEN part MUST match the iana_pen published in the manufacturer's well-known document (fleet binding, ADR-0018); the VPID part IS the HEMS serial, so no separate serial field exists (two serials, never mixed: the path carries the Steuerbox serial).

qr_info.description: SHIP-Info-Datensatz from the EEBUS QR content (SHIP;SKI:…;ID:…;FPH256:…;SPSEC:…;ENDSHIP;) — carries the FNN credential fingerprint and the SPSEC security code; mTLS is the secret's transport (ADR-0008/-0017), the MSB forwards it only via the box admin channel and never logs it. No separate fph or base_uri field.
